prompt: In an anime style illustration, a bustling fire station interior reveals a complex tableau of activity. On the far left stands a tall firefighter in a yellow helmet, leaning against a polished red fire engine that dominates the foreground. Next to the engine, a small tabby cat sits calmly on a coiled black hose. The firefighter in the yellow helmet is looking at a clipboard held by a woman in a blue uniform standing center-left. She is pointing at a specific line on the paper while speaking to a young boy in a green jacket who stands beside her. The boy is holding a shiny silver badge tightly in his right hand. Behind them, a large wall clock with Roman numerals hangs high above a row of lockers. A man in a gray sweater sits on a wooden bench beneath the clock, tying his boot laces. To his right, a brown dog lies asleep on a faded rug, its tail twitching slightly. In the center of the room, a chef in a white hat stirs a pot on a portable stove, steam rising visibly into the air. He is handing a bowl of soup to a girl in a pink dress who reaches out eagerly. The girl is sitting on a stack of orange crates near the kitchen area. Above them, a ceiling fan spins slowly, casting soft shadows. On the far right, an old man in a tweed cap leans on a cane, watching the scene with a gentle smile. Beside him, a bicycle with a wicker basket rests against the wall. A parrot in a colorful cage hangs from a hook near the bicycle, squawking loudly. The parrot is looking at a child in a striped shirt who is feeding it a cracker through the bars. Near the entrance, a pair of muddy boots sits by the door mat. A woman in a purple coat hangs her keys on a hook next to the boots. She is talking to a man in a suit who checks his wristwatch impatiently. The man in the suit stands next to a potted fern that adds a touch of green to the industrial space. There is no smoke visible in the air. There is no fire burning in the station. There is no alarm light flashing on the walls.
